description.value: Indigenous-owned full-service RV resort and marina on Esquimalt Harbour with waterfront views of Victoria's inner harbour, less than 4 km from downtown; designed exclusively for large motorhomes with no tent sites and RV rates starting at $82/night, making it a poor fit for most cycle tourists.

raw_osm.name: Salish Seaside RV Haven
raw_osm.source: ParcelMap BC Parcel Fabric; Esquimalt Zoning Bylaw; Canada Post

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website identifies this as 'Salish Seaside RV Resort & Marina', differing from the OSM name 'Salish Seaside RV Haven'. The site is a premium RV resort with 37 pads designed for large motorhomes (18'–50'), owned by the Songhees and Esquimalt Nations. Website confirms showers, laundry, Wi-Fi, and online reservations. OSM tags tents=yes but the website makes no mention of tent or hiker/biker camping — all sites are sized for RVs — so suitability for touring cyclists without an RV is unclear.
